title: Dicewell chopper: one onion, no tears, four seconds

product.name: Dicewell Pull Chopper
product.one_liner: a pull-cord chopper that dices an onion in a closed bowl

presenter.description: fictional man in his forties, apron, kitchen; generated, not based on anyone

hook.text: If onions make you cry, watch this.
hook.why: Calls out a specific annoyance and promises a visual payoff.

style: candid kitchen phone footage, overhead and eye level, natural light

shots.visual: Presenter drops a halved onion into the chopper bowl and snaps the lid shut
shots.caption:
if onions make you cry, watch this
AI-generated ad
shots.voiceover: If onions make you cry, watch this.

prompt.subject: fictional man in his forties wearing a dark apron, dropping half an onion into a clear plastic chopper bowl
prompt.action: he drops the onion in and snaps a white lid shut with a click

shots.visual: Presenter to camera, eyes watering, knife and a sad pile of uneven onion on the board
shots.caption: the knife way: tears, uneven, board to wash
shots.voiceover: The knife way: minutes of stinging eyes and pieces the wrong size.

prompt.subject: the same fictional man, eyes slightly watery, gesturing at a cutting board with roughly chopped onion
prompt.action: he wipes one eye with his wrist and points at the board
prompt.audio: kitchen room tone, a tap dripping

shots.visual: Overhead: hand pulls the cord four times, the onion inside turns to even dice
shots.caption: pull. pull. pull. pull.
shots.voiceover: Pull the cord. Pull. Pull. Pull. Lid stays on, so the onion gas stays in.

prompt.subject: overhead of a hand pulling a cord on a round chopper with a clear lid, onion inside
prompt.action: four quick pulls, the blades spin and the onion chunks become small even dice
prompt.negative: blade blur artifacts, onion flying out, extra hands

shots.visual: Lid comes off, dice tipped into a hot pan; presenter blinks at camera, dry-eyed
shots.caption: dry eyes. even dice.
shots.voiceover: Lid off, into the pan. Even dice, dry eyes.

prompt.subject: the fictional man lifting the lid and tipping diced onion into a hot pan on a stove
prompt.action: he tips the bowl, the dice slides out and sizzles, he glances at the camera
prompt.camera: handheld, eye level, slow drift left
prompt.lighting: window light plus a warm glow from the stove
prompt.audio: sizzle as the onion hits the pan

shots.visual: Bowl, lid and blade go into the dishwasher top rack; a hand holds the blade cartridge up to show it's one piece
shots.caption: three parts. top rack.
shots.voiceover: Three parts, all top-rack safe. The blade cartridge comes out as one piece, so nothing to pick at.

shots.visual: Presenter holds the chopper up next to the pan, nods toward the link
shots.caption: link below. one onion to convince you.
shots.voiceover: Link's below. It takes one onion to convince you.

prompt.subject: the fictional man holding the chopper up beside the pan, apron on
prompt.action: he holds the chopper toward the lens and nods downward

notes: The 'four seconds' in the title is a line in the title only; the script itself shows four pulls and makes no timed claim.
Shot 5 is real footage of the actual product in a dishwasher so the parts shown match what ships.
